policy: Bundle data when redistribution is clearly licensed. Otherwise fetch public/freeware/shareware/demo data from the recorded upstream/public source and stage it locally without committing it to source control.

homm2-demo.notes: The Heroes of Might and Magic II demo that fheroes2's own CMake GET_HOMM2_DEMO option and script/demo/download_demo_version.sh fetch; URL and SHA-256 are upstream's (fheroes2 c0e8128). Stage DATA/ and MAPS/ with stage_data.py. Never commit or bundle it. A player's own full Heroes II DATA/MAPS (and optional ANIM/MUSIC) replace it.
